name: promptos
description: Saved links, made findable. Cross-runtime skills for Claude Code and Codex that file everything you save into an organized, indexed, searchable knowledge base on your own computer.

plugins.name: promptos
plugins.description: Forward links from your phone; an AI researches each one, writes it a page, and files it. Set up with /promptos (builds the base on your computer, no accounts needed); run with /promptos:process (deep-mines videos with timestamps and screenshots, files into topical categories with searchable indexes, confirms to submitters); keep your machine in sync with /promptos:skills; review what has aged with /promptos:stalecheck (report only); put it online when you want with /promptos:publish.
